Either…or ……: You can either stay at home or go shopping with us.
你要么待在家里,要么和我们一起去购物。
take the subway: I take the subway to school every morning because it is fast.
我每天早上乘地铁上学,因为很快。
ride a bike: My brother learned to ride a bike when he was six years old.
我哥哥六岁时学会了骑自行车。
every day: She drinks a glass of milk every day to stay healthy.
她每天喝一杯牛奶来保持健康。
by bike: It takes about twenty minutes to get to the park by bike.
骑自行车去公园大约需要二十分钟。
think of: What do you think of the new movie at the cinema?
你觉得电影院新上映的这部电影怎么样?
between… and…: The bank is between the library and the post office.
银行在图书馆和邮局之间。
ropeway: The ropeway carries visitors over the river to the mountain village.
索道载着游客越过河流,到达那个山村。
come true: If you work hard, your dream will come true one day.
如果你努力工作,你的梦想总有一天会实现。
(be) on time: Please be on time for the meeting tomorrow morning.
请明天早上准时参加会议。
listen to…: Students should listen to the teacher carefully in class.
学生上课应该认真听老师讲课。
go out: Tom can't go out with his friends on school nights.
汤姆在上学的晚上不能和朋友外出。
do the dishes: After dinner, I usually do the dishes for my parents.
晚饭后,我通常帮父母清洗餐具。
make (one’s) bed: He makes his bed quickly before he goes to school.
他上学前快速铺好自己的床。
be strict (with sb): Our math teacher is strict with us, but we all like her.
我们的数学老师对我们要求严格,但我们都喜欢她。
follow the rules: Everyone in the library must follow the rules and keep quiet.
每个人在图书馆都必须遵守规则,保持安静。
koala: The koala sleeps for many hours during the day in the tree.
考拉白天在树上睡好几个小时。
kind of: I am kind of tired after running for two hours.
跑了两个小时后,我有点累了。
South Africa: These lovely elephants come from South Africa, a big country in Africa.
这些可爱的大象来自南非,一个非洲大国。
get lost: The little boy got lost in the big shopping mall yesterday.
昨天小男孩在大型购物中心里迷路了。
be in (great) danger: Many wild animals are in great danger because forests are disappearing.
许多野生动物处于极大的危险之中,因为森林正在消失。
cut down: We should not cut down too many trees for paper.
我们不应该为了造纸砍伐太多树木。
(be) made of: This beautiful table is made of wood from old houses.
这张漂亮的桌子是由老房子的木头制成的。
Julie: Julie is my best friend, and she sits next to me in class.
朱莉是我最好的朋友,上课时坐在我旁边。
Becky: Becky often helps her mother clean the house on weekends.
贝姬周末经常帮妈妈打扫房子。
Thai: My new friend is Thai, and he speaks both Thai and English.
我的新朋友是泰国人,他既说泰语又说英语。
read a newspaper: My grandfather reads a newspaper every morning after breakfast.
我爷爷每天早饭后看报纸。
make soup: Mom is making chicken soup for us in the kitchen.
妈妈正在厨房里给我们做鸡汤。
go to movies: We often go to movies with our classmates on Saturday evenings.
我们经常在周六晚上和同学一起去看电影。
eat out: Our family likes to eat out at a small restaurant on Friday.
我们一家人喜欢周五出去,在一家小餐馆吃饭。
drink tea: Many old people in China drink tea and chat in the afternoon.
中国许多老人下午喝茶聊天。
the United States: Her uncle moved to the United States to work two years ago.
她叔叔两年前搬到美国去工作了。
Dragon Boat Festival: People eat zongzi and watch boat races during the Dragon Boat Festival.
端午节期间,人们吃粽子、观看龙舟比赛。
take a message: Can I take a message for your brother? He is not at home now.
我可以给你哥哥捎个口信吗?他现在不在家。
call(sb)back: I will call you back as soon as I finish my homework.
我一做完作业就给你回电话。
on(a)vacation: My parents are on vacation at the beach this week.
我父母本周在海边度假。
Boston: It often snows in Boston during the cold winter months.
在寒冷的冬季,波士顿经常下雪。
police station: The lost child stayed at the police station until his parents came.
走失的孩子待在警察局里,直到他父母来接他。
pay phone: There is a pay phone next to the small supermarket.
小超市旁边有一个付费电话。
across from: The hospital is across from the school, so it is easy to find.
医院在学校对面,所以很容易找到。
